//: The PM PLANNER's own settings layer (2026-09-12, planner-with-hands).
Passed as `--settings <this file>` with `--setting-sources ""` - no
ambient layer, same reasoning as copilot.json (the repo's Stop hook would
block a turn that writes no code).
WHY THE PLANNER HAS HANDS AT ALL: measured 2026-09-12 - the plan turn
used to run `--permission-mode plan` with NOTHING to fetch and only the
LIVE board inlined. 200 finished cards and 40 memory notes were invisible,
so it asked the owner whether a Google-Play account exists while eight
finished cards + a live card + memory note said the app is IN REVIEW, and
re-asked the timeline question three days after memory recorded it as
answered. Industry rule (Anthropic context engineering, Devin interactive
planning, Kambhampati LLM-Modulo): the planner VERIFIES its premises with
tools before it plans or asks; history is fetched by id/query, never
inlined. The allow list below is exactly those read-only fetch tools -
relative to cwd=daemon/, the same form copilot.json grants Henry.
Nothing that writes, ships, spawns or leaves the repo: Write/Edit/Agent
denied, and the planner's answer is JSON the harness parses - a plan
PROPOSES, code disposes (pm_triangle).
PowerShell entries (measured 2026-09-12, stream-json): the CLI's Bash tool
runs Git-Bash where `py` is NOT on PATH (exit 127), the model then retries
in the PowerShell tool, which needs its own allow rule or it dies with
'requires approval'. Both tools are therefore allowed for the same
read-only command, and EVIDENCE_TOOLS tells the planner to use PowerShell.
ONE command (state-into-db phase B, 2026-09-12): the planner's cwd is a
throwaway scratch folder outside the repo holding only hd.py, a wrapper
pm._scratch_cwd() generates per turn that dispatches to board_state.py /
henry_memory_get.py / git log by ABSOLUTE path. Why: on 2026-09-11 the
planner redirected a 105k-char board dump to a file so it could grep it -
a `:*` prefix rule cannot see a `>` redirect - and with cwd=daemon/ the
dump landed in the repo (daemon/board_full.txt). Now any stray write lands
in the scratch folder and dies with it. Relative ../ops paths would not
resolve from there and absolute paths carry spaces that break prefix
matching, hence the wrapper.
